### Wang Yangming on practice

Wang Yangming (1472–1529) approaches practice within Neo-Confucianism. Mind is principle; seeking principle only in external books misses the moral mind. Liangzhi is innate clear knowing that should be extended to all affairs. On this page, the archive isolates English passages where that project meets practice most directly—useful for searches such as “wang yangming quotes on practice.”

### How to use this page
